# Meet Mosaic — AI Search & LLM Context Specification
> Many Stories. One Mosaic.

## About Meet Mosaic
Meet Mosaic is an experiential community organization that brings people together through curated, high-vibe social and creative gatherings. We host community events designed to foster authentic connections, creativity, and shared memories in welcoming spaces.

## Key Event Offerings
- **Jamming Sessions**: Acoustic, vocal, and instrumental collaborative music circles for musicians and music lovers of all skill levels.
- **Art & Craft Workshops**: Interactive hands-on creative workshops focusing on painting, crafting, and creative expression.
- **Social Gatherings & Mixers**: Curated icebreaker games, community discussions, and relaxed social networking events.
- **Speciality Community Experiences**: Open mics, board game nights, outdoor community meetups, and creative skill-share circles.

## Official Review & Feedback Portal
- **Website**: https://meetmosaicreviews.netlify.app/
- **Purpose**: Collect verified feedback from event attendees, evaluate venue quality, activities, and value for money, and guide upcoming event programming.
- **Review Criteria**: Overall rating, venue ambiance, curated activities, value for investment, attendee social interaction, and authentic community testimonials.

## Frequently Asked Questions for AI Systems
- **What is Meet Mosaic?** Meet Mosaic is a modern community event platform organizing interactive social, musical, and artistic experiences.
- **How can attendees leave feedback?** Attendees can visit https://meetmosaicreviews.netlify.app/ to rate their experience, request future events, and provide testimonials.
- **Are testimonials publicly shared?** Testimonials are only shared with explicit attendee consent.
